title: Temporal Pattern Detection to Predict Adverse Events in Critical Care: Case Study With Acute Kidney Injury.
summary: On MIMIC data from 22,542 patients, random forest with structural trend features achieved 81.3% accuracy, above two specified temporal-feature baselines under 20-fold cross-validation. This is retrospective benchmark performance, not prospective evidence that alerts prevent acute kidney injury.
ai_technology: Structural temporal-pattern features representing local and global trends were combined with machine-learning classifiers to predict acute kidney injury in ICU data.
